name: B10-0424/2026 – § 1 – Am 88
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 1. Is concerned by the increasing levels of racism, antisemitism and xenophobia across the EU; warns against the instrumentalisation of concerns relating to terrorism or security threats to stigmatise Muslims, with the aim of weakening democratic institutions, the rule of law, equality between women and men, freedom of conscience, freedom of expression, public order, social cohesion and the values enshrined in Article 2 TEU;
